## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and what changes for users or contributors.

## Validation

List the exact commands and results. Include a focused regression for behavior
changes and identify untested platforms or live-model behavior. Scripted examples
are not model benchmark scores.

## Review notes

Explain any effect on deterministic behavior, evidence ordering, allowed
mutations, or unrelated-state checks. Note new dependencies or third-party
material, if any. Link the relevant issue when one exists.
